name: LibraryModel sources
description: Linux-safe state and logic behind Library's window: LibraryCatalog (photos, collections with counts, the selected collection, sort order, the loupe's photo, stepping and position), PhotoItem with its sort orders, metadata edits on the selected photos with mixed values (PhotoMetadata, PhotoFlag) and the metadata inspector's accessibility identifiers (MetadataInspectorID), 60 seeded sample photos, and LibraryThumbnailCache (the grid's held thumbnails, pending requests and size bucket, reading the catalog without changing it and returning failures as availability changes for applyThumbnailFailures).
